import styled from '@emotion/styled';

export const StyledAllTrainingsCard = styled.div({
  display: 'flex',
  flexDirection: 'column',
  justifyContent: 'space-between',
  width: '100%',
  minWidth: '205px',
  maxWidth: '215.25px',
  height: '100%',
  minHeight: '323px',
  maxHeight: '339.4px',
  padding: '16px',
  border: 'none',
  borderRadius: '16px',
  backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
  cursor: 'pointer',
  transform: 'translateZ(0)',
  backfaceVisibility: 'hidden',
  WebkitFontSmoothing: 'antialiased',
  MozOsxFontSmoothing: 'grayscale',
  willChange: 'transform',

  transformOrigin: 'center',
  transition: 'transform 0.25s ease-in-out',
  '&:hover': {
    transform: 'scale(1.05) translateZ(0)',
  },
});

export const StyledAllTrainingsCardImages = styled.div({
  position: 'relative',
  display: 'grid',
  gridTemplateRows: 'repeat(2, 1fr)',
  gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(2, 1fr)',
  rowGap: '16px',
  columnGap: '16px',
  justifyItems: 'center',
});

export const StyledTrainingImage = styled.img({
  width: '100%',
  minWidth: '78.5px',
  maxWidth: '82.42px',
  height: '117px',
  borderRadius: '8px',
  objectFit: 'cover',
});

export const TrainingCounter = styled.div({
  position: 'absolute',
  boxSizing: 'content-box',
  display: 'flex',
  alignItems: 'center',
  justifyContent: 'center',
  width: '48px',
  height: '48px',
  top: '50%',
  left: '50%',
  transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
  borderRadius: '32px',
  border: '8px solid #FFFFFF',
  backgroundColor: '#006EDB',
  color: '#FFFFFF',
  fontFamily: 'Barlow',
  fontWeight: '600',
  fontStyle: 'SemiBold',
  fontSize: '24px',
  lineHeight: '120%',
  letterSpacing: '0%',
  textAlign: 'center',
});

export const StyledCtaLink = styled.p({
  color: '#006EDB',
  fontFamily: 'Work Sans',
  fontWeight: '500',
  fontStyle: 'Medium',
  fontSize: '12px',
  lineHeight: '16px',
  letterSpacing: '0%',
  textDecoration: 'underline',
  textDecorationStyle: 'solid',
  textAlign: 'end',
  margin: '0',
});
